movie.title: I Won't Die for Love
movie.overview: At 18, Claudia doesn't want to be a hero. Her mother's illness erupts like a silent storm, forcing a redefinition of roles in a family long estranged. Torn between the duty to care for her mother and the desire to live like any other girl her age, Claudia searches for a way to navigate this new reality, which will transform the bonds between the entire family.

aiEnrichment.summary_one_sentence: Facing her mother's sudden illness, eighteen-year-old Claudia must navigate the overwhelming burden of family caregiving while longing to live a normal teenage life.
aiEnrichment.summary_short: At eighteen years old, Claudia finds her life upended when her mother's sudden illness shatters their family's fragile dynamics. Thrust into a caregiving role for a mother from whom she was long estranged, Claudia struggles to balance heavy familial duty with her own desire for freedom and youth. As the silent storm of illness unfolds, the entire family is forced to confront past fractures and redefine their bonds. Ultimately, Claudia must find a path through this new reality without losing her own sense of self.
aiEnrichment.summary_long: Claudia is an eighteen-year-old girl on the brink of adulthood, eager to experience life like any other young woman her age. However, her world changes instantly when her mother is diagnosed with a sudden, debilitating illness that shakes the foundation of their home. Having experienced years of family estrangement, the abrupt shift forces everyone to abruptly step into roles they were never prepared to play. Claudia finds herself caught in a painful tug-of-war between filial obligation and her deep desire for personal independence. As the daily reality of caregiving sets in, long-buried emotional tension and unhealed wounds resurface among family members. Claudia must adapt to the relentless demands of her mother's care while attempting to hold onto her youth and identity. The illness acts as a silent storm, stripping away old resentments and demanding radical vulnerability from the family. Through shared hardship and quiet moments of sacrifice, the relational bonds between Claudia and her relatives begin to alter and evolve. As Claudia matures through this trial, she learns to navigate love, grief, and resilience, proving that survival means forging a new way forward together.
aiEnrichment.synopsis: Claudia is an 18-year-old girl who never asked to be a hero, yet finds her youth disrupted when her mother falls severely ill. The diagnosis acts as a silent storm within a family already marked by emotional distance and estrangement, forcing each member to confront their shared past and redefine their traditional roles. Torn between a deep sense of duty to care for her ailing mother and the natural craving to live freely like any other teenager, Claudia struggles to navigate the heavy emotional and physical weight placed upon her shoulders. 'Yo no moriré de amor' explores the nuanced realities of young caregiving, family reconciliation, and the tender, chaotic process of growing up under extraordinary circumstances.

story_structure.climax: A critical turning point forces the family to confront their long-standing estrangement and face the emotional reality of their situation head-on.
story_structure.conflict: Claudia faces an internal and practical struggle between her sense of duty to care for her mother and her desire to live her own independent life.
story_structure.resolution: The family forms a redefined bond, and Claudia arrives at a new understanding of love, autonomy, and her place within her family.
story_structure.introduction: Claudia is an 18-year-old girl yearning for a normal youth, but her world changes when her mother falls ill, disrupting the fragile dynamic of their already estranged family.
story_structure.risingAction: As her mother's illness worsens, Claudia navigates shifting family roles, strained relationships, and the growing emotional weight of her caregiving responsibilities.
